HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:COLLEAGUES (7) has gait issues but he appears to be hard to beat against this class if he delivers a fool proof display. He was going to finish in second at Maryborough last week but broke stride at the 100m mark and ended up being placed in fifth. OLIVER SMUDGE (5) hasn’t raced since May 2023 but he was a runaway trial winner at Maryborough last week. He is nicely bred and strikes a suitable assignment for his first up performance so he cannot be underestimated. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) is resuming since December and hasn’t been to the trials but she is worth thought from the pole position. LITTLER (2) is ideally drawn and is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: COLLEAGUES (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (5), SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1), LITTLER (2)

OVERVIEW:PIRANI PERFECT (4) has been placed in both of her starts since transferring to trainer Rebecca Bartley and met a stronger field when second behind Crackin Philtra in a slick mile rate of 1.56.0 at Kilmore last outing. She possesses early speed and gets her chance to break through for a win. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was slow away and settled a clear last early when fifth at Swan Hill last outing. He was placed at his five attempts prior and should be hitting the line strongly. ROJENBYE (3) performs well at Charlton having been placed in four of his six starts (2 wins) to date. He is better drawn than his recent performances and gets his chance to improve on his numerical form. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6) disappointed at Hamilton last week but he is a fast beginner and this race is easier so he can show improvement. BACK: PIRANI PERFECT (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PIRANI PERFECT (4), MAJOR LINCOLN (7), ROJENBYE (3), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6)

OVERVIEW: LOU EASYANA (8) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a spell and finished very nicely when second behind Huxham Chubb at Hamilton last week. This race appears to be easier so she is a good chance of going one better now. TOTALLY STUNNING (7) has returned from a spell in good form having been placed in all of her four attempts and looms as one of the leading chances again. She finished quickly to win at Shepparton on September 15 and finished off well for third in a slick mile rate of 1.53.9 at Wagga last outing. HUNGRY HOGARTH (3) settled midfield, raced fiercely and finished off solidly for a close second at Swan Hill last outing. This race is no harder and he should be competitive again. LEONARD (6) sustained a flat tyre when in the leading role and had excuses last outing. He led throughout at a recent Swan Hill victory and is worth another chance. BACK: LOU EASYANA (8) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: LOU EASYANA (8), TOTALLY STUNNING (7), HUNGRY HOGARTH (3), LEONARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ICANMOTOR (7) has had several chances since his latest victory but he was placed three times in succession against similar grade back in October and should run a good race again despite the wide draw. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2) is a fast beginner and gets his chance to improve on his recent efforts. He met a stronger field at Hamilton on October 26 and is backing up quickly from his effort at Mount Gambier on Friday night. GO GEORGE GO (4) is a grinding type that finished third from behind the leader at his latest appearance. He has had four starts on the track for a win and a third and is worth thought under these conditions. MY LUCKY ROCK (1) has been safely held at her two starts back from a break but she should be getting fitter and her form last preparation would suggest she can be competitive against this line up. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (7), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2), GO GEORGE GO (4), MY LUCKY ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW:SPORTS WRACK (4) hasn’t won a race in 19 starts for the season but this is his easiest assignment for a long time and he has the early speed to give a forward showing. He settled midfield on the markers when sixth behind Krissy at Kilmore last outing. JAMES GARNER (8) is resuming since a fourth at Ararat in March and hasn’t been to the trials but he would go close if he is somewhere near his peak. NO EMOTION (2) will appreciate a slight drop back in class and wasn’t beaten by far at his latest Charlton appearance behind Eyesealittle and Huxham Chubb (won twice since). He is drawn to run a good race. OUTBACK QUEENIE (9) has performed below her best since resuming but she appears to be better placed against this field and gets her chance to improve. SELECTIONS: SPORTS WRACK (4), JAMES GARNER (8), NO EMOTION (2), OUTBACK QUEENIE (9)

OVERVIEW: It is an open race with many winning chances. HALF AS TOUGH (11) settled midfield and came out three horses wide from the 600m when a creditable second behind the smart 2yo pacer Dispersion at Hamilton last week. He is poorly drawn but should be competitive again. IDEAL HIGH (7) followed HALF AS TOUGH (11) all of the way and held his own over the latter stages when third in the same race last week. He should continue to benefit from race experience and is worth an investment. ITS HYDROMATIC (6) has only been placed once in 21 starts but he was performing nicely at the trials prior to a fast finishing sixth when resuming at Kilmore so he gets his chance to improve. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) ran a reasonable race when third behind Millies Boy at her Victorian debut and is not without a chance. BACK: HALF AS TOUGH (11) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HALF AS TOUGH (11), IDEAL HIGH (7), ITS HYDROMATIC (6), KELLYS COMMOTION (10)

OVERVIEW: MISSMALACHITE (4) continues to perform consistently having been placed in six of her past eight starts and missed out by a narrow margin at Ballarat last outing. She possesses early speed and should make her presence felt. LESTER (9) is resuming since May and hasn’t been to the trials but he should prove hard to beat if he is close to his peak. He has won a race at Charlton previously and gets into this race nicely with a concession claim. YANKEE GAMBLER (10) should be building on his fitness after having two starts back from a spell. He performs best when he is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he does have the ability to test this field. SKADI (2) led throughout at a Swan Hill victory on September 08 and has claims along with ESPERANZA (1) and ZEUSS (5), which will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. SELECTIONS: MISSMALACHITE (4), LESTER (9), YANKEE GAMBLER (10), ZEUSS (5)

OVERVIEW: SAINT EYES (3) settled midfield and was held up for a run at a vital stage before finishing stoutly for second behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last outing. His two efforts since resuming have been sound and he is worth thought again. CONNIES PRESIDENT (8) has won two of his past four starts and looms as one of the leading chances again. He trailed the leader after commencing from the inside of the second line when he won at Horsham two starts ago then picked up ground from the second half of the field at Maryborough. WHY NOW (11) commenced from the tough handicap of 40m when third behind the in-form mare Keayang Minnesota at his latest performance so he is worth thought from the same mark against this slightly easier grade. ATABOY CHARLIE (4) has performed below his best form in two starts back from a break but he is a fast beginner and should be getting fitter so he is worth thought. SELECTIONS: SAINT EYES (3), CONNIES PRESIDENT (8), WHY NOW (11), ATABOY CHARLIE (4)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) is a former New Zealander, which was performing well at the trials prior to a third in the West Wyalong Cup on his Australian debut, where he commenced from the second line and was driven aggressively to find the lead with two laps remaining. He appears to be ideally placed from the pole position and will take beating. MY MATE ACE (3) is stepping up in class but is racing at his peak form and is a chance of completing four straight victories. He trailed the leader and used the sprint lane when he defeated Tryx Vixen (won since) at Kilmore last outing. THE WISE GUY (2) was resuming since August 2025 when he worked home reasonably well for third behind Decode in a sizzling mile rate of 1.54.9. He should have benefited from that performance and is better drawn so he must be considered as a winning chance. RABADA (5) is resuming but was racing at Metropolitan level at his last campaign and has claims along with EMILY VINCENT (7) and MISTER JIMARINGLE (10), which bounced back to his best form with a win in a career best mile rate of 1.54.5 at Kilmore last outing. BACK: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1), MY MATE ACE (3), THE WISE GUY (2), RABADA (5)

OVERVIEW: SURETHING (7) was resuming since a victory at Mildura in June when she attempted to lead early, was stranded without cover and eased back to the markers to settle three back at her latest creditable second. She should be fitter from that performance and is capable of overcoming the poor draw. ROCKAMARA (8) has only been successful once in 13 attempts but that victory was at Melton over Sheer Me (won twice since) and the mile rate was a quick 1.55.7. Her recent efforts have been in South Australia and she must be considered as a winning chance on her Victorian return. BUBBLE OVER (9) was resuming since May when third behind the smart pacer Colosimo at Terang. She should be fitter from that run and is worth following. PHILS BOY (5) beaten the easier Maiden class at Mildura last outing but he won easily and has improved with every start to date. He is worth thought along with JANSEN (10), which was a winner at Maryborough on October 12. SELECTIONS: SURETHING (7), ROCKAMARA (8), BUBBLE OVER (9), PHILS BOY (5)

ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (4) flashed home late when narrowly beaten last start at Burnie. His form has been hit and miss since arriving in the state, but at his best, he looks one of the clear fancies here. CONSORT NZ (5) arrives from New South Wales, and you would expect that form to stand up in a field like this. He also looked to have something in reserve in a recent trial at Carrick. SPORT WATCHER (6) is consistent in this grade and looks next best, along with SPORTZSILK (2), who, if he brings his best behaviour and is able to find the front, could take some running down at odds. DANCINWIVJOLENE (3) could run into the placings, as can BARBETTE (7) with the right run in transit and some tempo on throughout. Selections:ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (4), CONSORT NZ (5), SPORT WATCHER (6), SPORTZSILK (2)

An extremely even field combines with a somewhat tricky speed map, but expect IDEN LADY LINCOLN (3) to push forward from her draw and look to find the front, where she may take some running down after three solid efforts since resuming from a long break. MERRYWOOD PAUL (4) continues to threaten to break through for his first win in the state and, despite drawing an awkward gate, can't be dismissed. MOVESLIKEALADY (9) should appreciate the smaller field and, with any tempo during the running, could take some holding out late. At his best, BAIL DENIED (2) could easily win a race like this from the nice draw. KARALTA ARTEMIS (7) again draws the outside gate for the fourth time in a row and will be relying on tempo throughout, while IDEN OLIVER (8) is going better than his past few runs suggest and could be a chance at odds if she gets clear running late. Selections:IDEN LADY LINCOLN (3), BAIL DENIED (2), MOVESLIKEALADY (9), MERRYWOOD PAUL (4)

The $20,000 Fillies Championship is another tricky speed-map race to assess. TWILIGHT STORM (8) was a strong winner in fast time last start when able to get her own way in front, and although she draws as the lone back-row runner here, her class could prevail. QUEEN ANASTASIA (5) was somewhat back to her handy two-year-old form when resuming last start, despite doing the work outside the leader. If she holds that form, she looks the testing material for the favourite. STAYZBETTER (1) resumes from a long break but was more than handy in her two-year-old races last season. Her trial during the week looked as though she is back on track, and if anywhere near her best, she could take some beating from the ideal pole draw. A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (2) and SWEETHEART DIOR (4) have been consistent since arriving in the state and you would expect both to push forward from their draws, while JILLSTIGER (4), SUMTHIN ELSE (6) and QUETZALLI (7) will be relying on some solid tempo throughout to allow them to get into the finish. It wouldn't surprise to see any of them bob up and win in an even race. Selections:TWILIGHT STORM (8), QUEEN ANASTASIA (5), STAYZBETTER (1), SWEETHEAT DIOR (3)

The boys' division for the three-year-olds, where PORT RUN MACHINE will look to continue on his winning ways after two very impressive performances at his past two starts. He should be off the pegs early and into the running line, where driver Gareth Rattray will have options whether to put him into the race or come with one run, but either way he should be extremely hard to beat. ROCKY STRIDE (7) is a super-consistent pacer who has been racing against older horses and should appreciate getting back to his own age here. While the draw does hurt his chances, he looks the clear danger to the favourite. IYLAC CHAMBER (2) should appreciate the better draw and may attempt to find the pegs, where he could run into the placings. TAPPY (6) will be relying on some tempo throughout to allow him to run home strongly, as he usually does. WHERE IT BEGAN (1) was a trial black booker on Monday night, recording a quick last half, and could run a race at odds if he brings his best behaviour. WINNING BREW (3) and HIGH BELIEVER (4) have been in good form but face somewhat of a class rise here and will be looking to run into the placings with some luck in running. Selections:PORT RUN MACHINE (8), ROCKY STRIDE (7), TAPPY (6), IYLAC CHAMBER (2)

OUR NAKED ART (5) couldn't have done much more first up in the state when doing work early and running second in very fast time in the open mares race. She draws a very awkward gate here for a horse who lacks any real gate speed, but her class can't be ruled out. MUZZAME MATE (4) continues to run good races without winning and may push forward looking to benefit from some cover in running. REMMINGTON (2) has been racing well and, although rising sharply in class here, can't be ruled out from the nice draw. SNOWIEWILLREV (1) and JOHN VINCENT (3) will look to take advantage of their good front-row draws to find spots on speed and give themselves their best chances. PREPARATION (10) got the gap when he needed it first up when saluting last start and will appreciate any tempo throughout to allow him to run home strongly, as will ATOMIC BLACK (12), with those two looking the best of the back-row runners. Selections:OUR NAKED ART (5), MUZZAME MATE (4), PREPARATION (10), ATOMIC BLACK (12)

A rare full field combines for the Group 2 two-year-old fillies, where DANGER BEWARE (10) looked ultra-impressive on debut after copping interference in the running but still proving too fast late in her heat. She will be relying somewhat on a solid tempo throughout from her back-row draw, which I would expect to come from stablemate KOOKY (5), who will be pushing hard from her middle front-row gate in an attempt to find the front again, as she did in her heat win. She looked to be waiting for them after putting a gap on the field around the home turn before others interfered with her momentum, and clearly looks the testing material if she brings her best form. VINJETTA (2) is somehow still a maiden after putting together some top performances in the recent features and was narrowly run down late after doing all the work in the run last start. She gets the perfect draw here to sit on speed and gets her chance to finally break through. ELEANOR STREET (1) looked to be travelling well before breaking at the 500-metre mark in her heat when a short-priced favourite. She has since trialled well and will be looking to take advantage of the pole draw, most likely attempting to hold out FARRAHS LEGACY (3), who showed sharp gate speed last start before surrendering the lead and was another interfered with on the home turn. It wouldn't surprise to see her run a bold race at odds if she was able to be first to the pegs here. MON BELLE AMOUR (4) is another who was interfered with in that race and looks an improving type, while RAZZAMATAZ (6) looks the other winning chance but will need some luck from her awkward front-row draw to get into the finish. Selections:DANGER BEWARE (10), KOOKY (5), VINJETTA (2), ELEANOR STREET (1)

The draw has really opened up the boys' division of the two-year-old Tasbreds, where POGACAR (4) draws the best of the fancied runners. Expect him to push forward and find a spot on speed, which should make him hard to hold out late. MYSTERY MAIL (5), STABLE TALK (6) and BUILTTHEMANASTATUE (7) all have good gate speed when asked, and you would expect all three to come out looking to find positions on speed to give themselves their best chances. MYSTERY MAIL (5) was clearly the blackbooker of the heats at odds when running home sharply from back in the field to finish second to the standout two-year-old of the season, BETTOR THAN READY (8), who will need plenty of luck from his inside back-row draw, where his chance may rely on if OUR ROBS ROY (1) holds the front. CALZO SNIPER (9) should get a nice run through from his trailing back-row draw, while FARROH JOE (11) has put together two strong performances since arriving in the state and should be running home strongly. With any genuine tempo throughout, he could be hard to hold out late. Selections: FARROH JOE (11), MYSTERY MAIL (5), BETTOR THAN READY (8), POGACAR (4)

ANN PENNY (1) takes on the older horses here but looked very sharp when showing brilliant gate speed last week and winning comfortably. Expect she gets her chance to lead all the way, with not a whole lot of gate speed amongst the other front-row runners outside of KUHIO CREST (3), who should push forward from his handy draw and has put together a couple of good performances of late in this sort of grade. REALLY SMARTIE (2) should get a perfect run from barrier two throughout and gets his chance to be in the finish, while SPOOKY GIRL (8), at her best, could be the one at odds from the nice back-row draw trailing the expected short-priced favourite. KENYA (12) can never be ruled out in these sorts of races, but his task is made harder from outside the back row over the short distance when he usually likes to be put into the race. QUEENOFDANCE (10) will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to run home strongly into the placings. Selections:ANN PENNY (1), REALLY SMARTIE (2), SPOOKY GIRL (8), KUHIO CREST (3)

HORATIUS SPECULO (3) will look to continue on his winning ways after another strong performance in good time when coming off the 20 metres last start. Whether he has to do the work outside the leader or finds the top, expect his class to prevail if he holds that form. WAVES OF CHANCE (2) has been super consistent of late and gets the draw to again find a nice spot on speed, where he will be looking to cross the pole marker in EVERYTHING BUT THE (1). He has really found his best form of late, winning three of his past four, but steps up into Free For All grade for the first time here. GO THE RED (4) will again look to be running home strongly to get into the placings, while STEPPING STONES (7) was very good first up from a break last week against the mares when leading them up three wide in a very slick time. Her chances could be tempo dependent here. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (3), WAVES OF CHANCE (2), STEPPING STONES (7), EVERYTHING BUT THE (1)

ALOT LIKE PENDLES (2) looks like taking no end of beating in the small field over the mile distance if he runs up to anything like his past two starts. SOHO TIGER LILY (1) does have good gate speed, but expect they may be happy to take the trail here behind the short-priced favourite after some somewhat inconsistent performances of late. LADY IN LINE (4) got the gaps when it mattered to win last start and will again be driven quietly, hoping to run home into the placings. The other runners in the field will need to improve on their recent performances to be a threat, unless SOUTHERN LUCK (3) can turn back the clock to his Easter Cup heat win earlier this year against Free For All horses. Selections:ALOT LIKE PENDLES (2), SOHO TIGER LILY (1), LADY IN LINE (4), SOUTHERN LUCK (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:EL LAZZAR (2) is racing in peak form and has the best barrier draw out of the major chances so he should prove hard to beat. He led throughout when a soft winner in a mile rate of 1.55.9 at Melton at his latest attempt. BELLA LOUISE (7) is also racing extremely well and should be competitive despite the poor draw. She defeated Major Drama (won since) at a Ballarat victory on October 01 and her recent third behind EL LAZZAR (2) was sound as she did all of the work in the run. LOWER MANHATTAN (11) recorded an impressive victory at Mildura when making his Victorian debut. He settled four back on the outside, came out three horses wide from the 800m and sustained a strong run to win clearly so he is worth thought again. FEEL THE REIGN (5) scored against similar opposition at Swan Hill two starts ago and has the speed to figure in the finish. OZZIE DAYBEAK (8) finished strongly at his first run since June and rates as a value chance. SELECTIONS: EL LAZZAR (2), BELLA LOUISE (7), LOWER MANHATTAN (11), FEEL THE REIGN (5)

OVERVIEW:TALKNPLAY (7) has performed extremely well at his two starts since December and is a good chance of completing a hat trick. He completely dominated his rivals when scoring by a very large margin at Kilmore last outing and scored with something in hand at Swan Hill prior. BETTOR DOO (5) finished off best from a nice trailing position when he scored at Melton last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but is meeting a field of similar quality and should go well again. FLEUR BELLA (6) began quickly to find the lead and kicked on strongly to defeat EAGLEYE (9) at Mildura last outing. She has won three of her past five starts and looms one of the leading chances again. THE AFRICAN QUEEN (10) finished off nicely for third at Mildura last outing and rates as a value hope. BACK: TALKNPLAY (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: TALKNPLAY (7), BETTOR DOO (5), FLEUR BELLA (6), THE AFRICAN QUEEN (10)

OVERVIEW: STORMS COLLIDE (7) began quickly to lead from the pole position, copped plenty of pressure down the back straight in a sizzling third quarter of 26.9 seconds and peaked late when fourth in the Super Series Final last outing. His overall form is very strong and he is sure to make his presence felt. FOX DAN (9) got past STORMS COLLIDE (7) and won the Super Series Final at his latest attempt so he should prove hard to beat again. He did enjoy the perfect trip when he scored last time out and is not as well drawn but he boasts the very good record of thirteen wins from just twenty-four starts. CALEXICO (8) pushed forward to park without cover from the 1100m and proved to be too strong in a handy mile rate of 1.54.3 at Swan Hill last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but should run his usual honest race. SOAP AND BUBBLES (6) finished strongly to score at Melton prior to a reasonable fourth in the Ladyship Cup. She is a classy mare and is worth a ticket each way. BACK: STORMS COLLIDE (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: STORMS COLLIDE (7), FOX DAN (9), CALEXICO (8), SOAP AND BUBBLES (6)

OVERVIEW: STAR VISION (7) created a big impression at his first three starts prior to contesting Super Series events. He drops back to a more suitable assignment now and is sure to be strongly fancied. HUXHAM CHUBB (3) produced a career best performance to win at Hamilton on Monday, where she settled down last and sustained a strong run in the final lap to win easily. This is a race of more depth but she is worth thought again. MAJOR DRAMA (2) is stepping up in class but is racing in great form and produced a big finale last time out. He is worth thought along with the fast beginner MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5), which has been racing in good form at Mildura. SELECTIONS: STAR VISION (7), HUXHAM CHUBB (3), MAJOR DRAMA (2), MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5)

OVERVIEW:THE FINAL DANCE (3) was competing in the Super Series (eighth in the Final) prior to a convincing win in a mile rate of 1.55.3 at Geelong then followed with a ninth in a heat of the Victoria Derby. He has been racing in strong grade and is drawn to give a bold showing. MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (10) returned from a spell in style with a convincing win at Mildura then finished unplaced after enduring a tough run on that track last time out. He won a heat of the Mildura Cup earlier in the season and was runner up in the Ouyen Cup so he has the class to test this field. BIZZNESS CLASS (7) is terribly drawn but he has been racing in outstanding form at Metropolitan level and he should be hitting the line strongly. LOUGLE (9) has won six races for the season and has been racing at a high level. He broke stride in the latter stages when looking a big winning chance at Swan Hill last outing and is worth another chance. TO THE NINES (6) is a versatile pacer that is racing in peak form and must be considered as one of the winning chances. He produced a big finish when an eye-catching third at Mildura two starts ago then didn’t have much room in the straight last outing. SELECTIONS: THE FINAL DANCE (3), MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (10), BIZZNESS CLASS (7), LOUGLE (9)

OVERVIEW:HOUSE PARTY (7) won the Mermaid Stakes in South Australia before competing in the Super Series where unplaced behind the star mare Theartofsuccess in the Final. She was surprisingly beaten into third ($1-12 fav) at Ballarat last outing but she worked hard in the run and is capable of bouncing back against this line up. THE END (4) was performing extremely well at the trials prior to winning softly against the Maiden class at his debut. He is a promising juvenile pacer and should go well again. FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (5) was resuming since January when he moved through to trail the leader at the 500m and worked into third behind Hez Harrywho at Shepparton. He should be fitter from that performance and is worth an investment. QUEENS BOULEVARD (6) is a fast beginner and is racing in good form. She led throughout at Stawell on September 14 and is capable of filling a place despite her wide draw. SELECTIONS: HOUSE PARTY (7), THE END (4), FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (5), QUEENS BOULEVARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ALTO CORAGGIO (1) has been runner up in all of his three starts to date and deserves to break through for a win. He pushed forward to find the lead and was run down in the latter stages when a close second behind Beryl’s Boots last outing. EVA EXPRESS (4) led out then took cover and finished fourth behind Pet Wolf in a slick mile rate of 1.54.9 at Melton last outing. She finished a close up fourth (2m) on debut and she should be competitive under these conditions. TAMALIA (3) attempted to lead throughout when a close third at Shepparton then followed with an unplaced effort in the race won by Pet Wolf at Melton. She might find this assignment to be more suitable and is worth a place ticket. KELCH (6) is yet to be placed in six starts to date but this is a slightly easier assignment so he is a possible improver. BACK: ALTO CORAGGIO (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: ALTO CORAGGIO (1), EVA EXPRESS (4), TAMALIA (3), KELCH (6)

OVERVIEW: TOORAM DANNY (4) settled midfield and finished off strongly to win easily at Swan Hill then took on a strong field when fifth behind Decode at Melton last outing. He appears to be well placed against this line up and looms as a strong winning chance. CRACKIN PHILTRA (5) pushed forward to find the lead, ran along at a good tempo and scored comfortably at Kilmore last outing. He is yet to miss a place in four starts to date and recorded a slick final half last time out so he should give another forward showing. XLENDI STAR (2) is resuming since a third at Mildura in May but will be fitter after finishing in third at a Bacchus Marsh trial on Saturday. He did well in two starts at his first preparation of racing and cannot be underestimated. CHAINSMOKE (3) produced a strong finish from midfield to score at Swan Hill when resuming then struck trouble and lost his chance at Kilmore. He is a speedy type and is a winning chance against this line up. BACK: TOORAM DANNY (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TOORAM DANNY (4), CRACKIN PHILTRA (5), XLENDI STAR (2), CHAINSMOKE (3)

PLACES YOU DONT (1) is always a handy from the inside draw. If she can lob behind the leader over the longer journey she should be storming home late. She looks like a strong chance in a very even race. CLARENDEN TRIBUTE (3) is racing in career best form. He is a major threat if he can keep producing the runs he has been producing. LOCHINVAR LEADER (4) and FULL BROTHER (6) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (3) finds a tougher race tonight but he has won four of his last five starts. If he gets the right run it’s hard to see him losing tonight. HEEZ A VIBE (5) looks like a strong chance tonight after winning two of his last five starts. MIKIS BEAUTY (10) and ALWAYSBEALADY (6) are also major chances.

THE VICARS GIRL (3) should have the speed to lead tonight. If she leads from the mobile start she will be extremely hard to pass. She is worth strong consideration. REGAL ATTIRE (5) loves the mobile start and his recent runs against tougher fields have been solid without winning. He is a major chance tonight. KYVALLEY HEIST (6) and MY BAD HABITS (2) are also chances.

HILLTOP CRUNCH (3) was a last start winner at Port Pirie when he defeated FARROH GODDESS by 5.4 meters. He has shown ability. If he can pace smoothly then the draw will help him out today. NO GOOD REASON (4), MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6) and UP THE BOMBER (7) are also chances.

SISTER PATRICK (6) has been so impressive since returning from a spell. She defeated NOTHING I WANT last start by a neck. She will love the mobile start tonight. It’s hard to see her getting beaten. IMA DESTROYER (1) will love the return to the mobile start and the inside draw tonight. She will be a big improver tonight. SAMMY BARBARO (5) and MAJESTIC SUMMER (2) are also chances.

HAPPY TO YA (4) made up a tonne of ground behind THE LAST TRIP in a heat of the SA cup two weeks ago. If he can repeat that sort of run tonight he is a major chance. HEZROCKINROYALTY (5), LOCHINVAR MAGIC (1) and LORD ZARIAS (6) are also chances.

JAWSOFGOODTIME (2) has won her last three starts and she is a massive chance of finding the lead again tonight. If she leads she will be extremely hard to pass. TWIN CONNECTION (3) looks like a big danger. If he can get the right run into the race he will be hitting the line well. DELIGHTFUL DREAM (4) and NIGHT SPIRIT (1) are also chances.

SEASIDE SHOW (3) ran second behind STEAM MACHINE two starts ago. She has been racing well since coming to SA without winning. If she can find the lead tonight which she can easily do with her gate speed she will be hard to beat. PARISIAN BANDIT (2), LOCHINVAR RULER (9) and LIGHTNING BLING (8) are also chances. CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4) will look to get back into the winner's circle in this No More Than Four Wins event after being more than competitive in the open mares race last week. OUR WILLOW (1) will be looking to make use of the pole draw, where they will have options whether to lead all the way or take a sit, but she looks to get her chance to be in the money yet again. ANGEL ROCKS (3) returns from a let-up and you would expect her to continue improving, being the lightly raced four-year-old mare that she is. UNMATCHED (6) uses the driver claim to gain entry into this race and was racing well in the four-year-old features last preparation. He could be hard to hold out if some of the more fancied runners set a decent tempo throughout. Selections:CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4), OUR WILLOW (1), ANGEL ROCKS (3), UNMATCHED (6)

Most of these went around at Burnie last week from the standing start, where REPETITIVE (1) broke through for a deserved victory. He should sit on speed with the other quick beginner in OUR BETTER BRO (2) and give the rest of the field something to chase. SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (5) can never be ruled out in these types of races. The remainder of the field probably have a little more class than the front runners but face slight handicaps over the middle distance, where TULLAH GIRL (6) and ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9) look the best of those coming off their Burnie runs. Selections:TULLAH GIRL (6), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9), OUR BETTER BRO (2), REPETITIVE (1)

It's a low-class event of the night, where JAY MILLER (3) will be looking for back-to-back victories after putting in a dominant display as an even-money favourite last start, going on to win by 10.6 metres. He should be able to settle on speed from the draw here and take some beating over the mile. FIVE STAR SHARK (6) resumes from a let-up and has blistering gate speed when right, so expect them to push forward hard from the draw. He hasn't been at his best for a while now, but if he's able to recapture some of his best sprinting form, he could take some catching. TUFFTIGER (2) resumes from a let-up for a new stable and gets his chance to run an improved race, while STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8) and KIAVINO STRIDE (11) look the best of the back-row runners if there is some tempo on throughout. Selections:JAY MILLER (3), TUFFTIGER (2). FIVE STAR SHARK (6), STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8),

Another race over the mile distance, where DOLCE DRAMA (6) will be looking to use her sharp gate speed to find a spot near the front. Her past three performances have been good enough to take out a field such as this if she is able to find a handy position. DAISYPEA (3) should be able to settle on speed with cover and gets her chance to improve, while she could be hard to hold out if she recaptures her good two-year-old form. MY BAD (5) has put together some improved performances of late but strikes an awkward front-row draw here. With some luck in running, she could still be in the finish. GOT THE GLOW (2) could be hard to beat if she brings her best behaviour from the nice draw, while GOBSMACKED (10) looks the best of the back-row runners and should be storming home if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections:DOLCE DRAMA (6), GOT THE GLOW (2), DAISYPEA (3), GOBSMACKED (10)

A high-class race of the night brings together a competitive field, where there looks to be good gate speed early again over the short distance. LAID BACK (5) continues to loom as a winner and should be able to find a nice spot on speed and again be right there in the finish. COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1) was a handy winner in a similar field last start and gets a nice draw to sit on speed and get his chance with any luck. OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2) has put together a good record since arriving in the state and gets back to the mile distance, where she is best suited. Her chances would improve further if she was able to be first to the pegs here. HAY MIKI (3) and KOSTYUK LEIS (4) are always thereabouts in these sorts of fields and will also be hoping to find spots on speed in what looks a very even race. Selections:LAID BACK (5), COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1), OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2), HAY MIKI (3)

OUR DANCE MONKEY (1) was a very dominant winner last week after disappointing as a well-fancied runner at her previous starts. She looks likely to hold the lead which could make her very hard to run down if she brings last week's performance again. A DRAGON FOR JOE (2) looks clearly the testing material. Tactics will be interesting to see if they decide to duck to the pegs behind the expected leader in the small field, but on his prior performances he should be hard to hold out late with a nice run in transit. MORIKAWA (4) showed great ability as a two-year-old and has been off the scene for over 12 months. If he puts his best foot forward and steers better than he has in previous trials for the new camp, he could easily be winning here, so the market may be the best guide. Expect the winner to come from those three favoured runners, while COOLANDCOLLECT (5) and NATIONAL NEWS (3) look the best of the rest and consistently earn cheques for their connections. Selections:OUR DANCE MONKEY (1), A DRAGON FOR JOE (2), MORIKAWA (4), NATIONAL NEWS (3)

COLORADO GIRL (2) broke through for her second career victory when a somewhat easy winner last week at Burnie and gets the draw here to find a nice spot on speed. She will most likely be first to the pegs, which will give them options from there. KYRGIOS (5) is threatening to break through after being the bridesmaid numerous times of late and will no doubt be running home strongly again from the awkward draw. PUNTARNO STRIDE (3) will look to use his good gate speed in an attempt to find the front but needs to improve on recent performances to be finishing off strongly enough to score. MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7) draws the outside of the front row, so will be hoping for some tempo at some point during the race. It wouldn't surprise to see her running home strongly and proving hard to hold out if that occurs. NO NUKES SKIPPER (4) looks the best of the rest after putting together some improved performances at recent starts, while BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1) gets her chance to improve from the pole draw in this field. Selections:COLORADO GIRL (2), KYRGIOS (5), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7), BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1)

The maidens round out the night, where the usual suspects do battle in an attempt to break their duck. LETHAL REPLICA (5) looked like the winner last start at the 400m mark before breaking gait. If she is on her best behaviour here, you would expect her to take some holding out off that performance. VOODOO RANGER (1) and ARRIVAL TIME (3) will again look to find forward positions from their nice draws and should be in the money again, while their stablemate CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) just needs to score up and race tractably throughout to be running home strongly. REID GRANT (4) was okay first up from a long break and looks to have some improvement to come, as will HARLEY GLENWOOD (2), who also resumes from a break without a trial, making it hard to gauge exactly where he is at, but he did show some ability earlier in the year. Selections:LETHAL REPLICA (5), REID GRANT (4), VOODOO RANGER (1), CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

ALCOMBZ (2) has been racing well without winning in Victoria. Tonight he finds a much easier race from a strong draw. He looks like the one to beat. BROWN EYED KATE (5), SUPREME DOLL (4) and ITGETSBETTER (7) are also chances.

LAMBRO LOUELLA (3) was a last start winner at Horsham when she defeated DISPERSION by a half neck. She is a great chance of leading all of the way tonight. She is going to be very hard to beat. EASTBRO MIKA (6) looks like a big danger after her recent form in Victoria. BANGBANG ROBBIE (1) and WICKED THREE (2) look the next best.

YNOBE NOVA (3) has been knocking on the door for a win in tricky races across the border. She has the gate speed to lead today and she does her best racing when she can find the top. GOLD IN PARIS (5) is better than her last run and she could easily bounce back in a race like this. ALLGOOD VINNIE (2) and VILLAGE VOICE (1) are also chances.

ALWAYS BE TECHY (5) ran a very nice race from a tough draw last start at Horsham. David Drury has his stable flying at the moment and this mare finds a very winnable race tonight. MALANI JOH (3) looks like a big danger and could easily be a big improver in this sort of race. BAYSIDE VICTORY (4) and WATCH IT HAPPEN (1) are also chances.

MAYBEDONTKNOW (1) is a well bred mare with a trainer and driver who must be respected in this sort of race from the inside draw. It may pay to watch her market moves. FRENCH PLEASURE (9), WITH A BITTA LUCK (5) and OCEAN STORM (8) are also big chances in the most tricky race of the night.

LIVERMERE (4) was a winner four starts back at Ballarat. Her recent form has been consistent and she has always been around the mark. She is worth consideration tonight. ITTAKESLUV (5), THE IRISHMAN (1) and GLENFLYER (2) are also chances. Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:CASTLES IN THE SKY (5) ran a good race in the leading role when resuming at Horsham, disappointed at her next attempt then followed with a game second at Maryborough. The move to the front line is a definite advantage and she should give a forward showing. BETSY ANNE (6) trailed the leader and battled on fairly well for third behind I’m Miss Royalty at Maryborough last outing. She places more often than she wins but she strikes a very suitable assignment here and should take beating. TOUCHANDGO (7) did well after a slow beginning for third at Maryborough two starts ago then followed with a fourth behind the handy type Keayang Minnesota. He has a tough draw to overcome but is capable of running into a place. MAJOR MAX (3) is a strong trotter, which finished third after finding the front at Kilmore three starts ago. He is drawn to suit his racing pattern and is worth thought. SELECTIONS: CASTLES IN THE SKY (5), BETSY ANNE (6), TOUCHANDGO (7), MAJOR MAX (3)

OVERVIEW:AT THE DISTANCE (2) raced on the outside of the leader throughout and battled on well when a close third at Kilmore two starts ago. He led and galloped after being overtaken approaching the home turn at Maryborough last outing but he is worth another chance under these conditions. JESSICAS STORY (3) performs best when she is able to lead out then take cover so she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. She was placed at Kilmore on September 24, where she settled three back on the markers and finished well via the sprint lane so she is worth a ticket each way. BUCKLES FOR BERRY (4) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of finding the lead shortly after the start. He endured a tough run when fifth last outing and is capable of improving on his numerical form here. ARGYLE MUSE (7) will appreciate a slight drop back in class for this assignment and finished off well for third at Maryborough on October 12 so he is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: AT THE DISTANCE (2), JESSICAS STORY (3), BUCKLES FOR BERRY (4), ARGYLE MUSE (7)

OVERVIEW: WALKING ON WATER (6) has been runner up in four of her past five starts and is ready to break through for a win. She moved up without cover in the early stages and did well for second behind Franks Alot at Maryborough on Sunday. SUFFARELL HILL (4) showed a lot of promise in four starts at her first campaign of racing and looms as the danger. She hasn’t been to the trials but she will take plenty of beating if she is somewhere near her peak. SYNTAX ERROR (3) has shown improvement at her past two attempts and was working home well at her latest second behind Wedge Tail Eagle. This race is no harder and she is worth thought again. GYM QUEEN (2) made an early move to circle around and find the lead at the 1600m when a creditable third at Maryborough on Sunday. She is a maiden from 15 starts but she has been placed 9 times and she should be competitive again. SELECTIONS: WALKING ON WATER (6), SUFFARELL HILL (4), SYNTAX ERROR (3), GYM QUEEN (2)

OVERVIEW: CONNECT THE DOTS (1) was resuming since May when she led and gave a great sight in the $75,000 Yabby Dam Farms Classic at Menangle, being beaten on the line. She is ideally drawn over the sprint distance and should take catching. KYVALLEY DAYTONA (10) sprinted quickly in the home straight to defeat KYVALLEY DANNY (2) at a recent Kilmore trial performance. He obviously has ability and must be kept safe. THECANDYBARHEIRESS (6) finished sixth in the Graeme Lang Memorial at Melton last outing, where the winner produced a slick mile rate of 1.57.6. She will find this race to be more suitable and is worth an investment. WHERDASUNDONTSHINE (11) set up a slow tempo in the lead and was beaten on the line at Geelong last outing. He is nicely bred and should continue to improve with the benefit of race experience. NONREMARKABLE (8) never appeared to be comfortable in her gait and eventually galloped on her debut. She was heavily supported first up so she is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: CONNECT THE DOTS (1), KYVALLEY DAYTONA (10), THECANDYBARHEIRESS (6), WHERDASUNDONTSHINE (11)

OVERVIEW:HAPPY ESCAPE (7) is racing in fine form and should prove hard to beat again. He has been racing on the speed in standing start events and reverts to the mobile start but his past two runner up performances have been behind the smart mare Keayang Minnesota so he appears to be well placed against this class. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (1) settled in the second half of the field and was doing his best work at the end when second behind Beautiful Sunrise at Melton last outing. He places more often than he wins but he should be competitive against this line up. BET BET HOTSHOT (2) should gain a trail just off the pace and has been racing well enough to be competitive under these conditions. RASENGAN (6) is first up since July and hasn’t been to the trials but he was racing against better opposition when he was last in work. He has claims along with MODERN HOPE (8). BACK: HAPPY ESCAPE (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HAPPY ESCAPE (7), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (1), BET BET HOTSHOT (2), RASENGAN (6)

OVERVIEW:SONNYBOY (9) performs best when he is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he dominated a field of similar quality last week so he is clearly the horse to beat again. KYVALLEY MISTY (5) raced without cover on the outside of SONNYBOY (5) in the final lap last week and did well to hold down second position. She is racing well and should give another honest account from her reasonable draw. ROBERT JOHN (11) is resuming since July and hasn’t been to the trials but he was competing strongly at the end of his last campaign and he should be finishing off well if he is somewhere near his peak form. LOVE WHO (8) is awkwardly drawn but was a winner under similar conditions at Shepparton on August 18 and has the speed to figure in the finish. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) and NEDZA THRILLER (6) are both performing well enough to be worth thought in an open race. SELECTIONS: SONNYBOY (9), KYVALLEY MISTY (5), ROBERT JOHN (11), LOVE WHO (8)

OVERVIEW: BUSLIN BRODY (8) raced without cover for the majority of the trip and battled on well for third behind Kennys Son in a stronger race at Melton on Saturday night. He couldn’t have drawn worse but he is racing well enough to break through for a win under these conditions. OMNIA (5) led and faded into tenth at Maryborough on Sunday but she was meeting a much stronger field and raced fiercely in the early and middle stages. She appears to be better placed under these conditions and is worth another chance. DEEJAY DEX (9) hasn’t won a race since September 2024 but he has been placed in three of his past five starts and he did pick up ground from last at his latest creditable sixth. RASTAMON (7) trailed the leader and had his chance when a distant fifth in the race won by Kennys Son last week but he has early speed and this race is easier so he is capable of featuring prominently. SELECTIONS: BUSLIN BRODY (8), OMNIA (5),DEEJAY DEX (9), RASTAMON (7)

OVERVIEW: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1) is likely to be headed off at the start from the pole position but he will appreciate a big drop back in class for this assignment. He won the Super Series Bronze event in September, competed in the Need for Speed Prince series and he broke stride from the 1100m at his latest performance in the Scotch Notch Trot. He is a speedy type and will take holding out in the run to the finish. PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (3) is a brilliant beginner and is likely to try and lead throughout over the sprint distance. He led when second behind Majestic Monarch at Kilmore two starts ago. ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (4) didn’t shirk the task when a creditable sixth in the Victoria Oaks last outing. This race is easier and a bold showing is expected. JOE LOU (9) broke stride and lost all chance last outing but he had four wins and two seconds at his previous six attempts. He is a strong 4yo trotter and will take beating if he delivers a fool proof display. SHEZALOVER (7) ran a cheeky race in the leading role when resuming and has claims along with DONA AMALIA (8). BACK: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1), PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (3), ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (4), JOE LOU (9)

OVERVIEW: SHINELIKETHESUN (2) was checked and galloped at the start, settled a clear last and produced a big performance to finish second behind Miss Muscle (won again since) at Geelong then lost her chance after galloping at the 400m last outing. She is nicely drawn and will take beating against this line up. TAURAS (6) produced a dominant performance when a runaway winner at Horsham then followed with a third behind Miss Muscle. He continues to improve with the benefit of experience and looms as one of the leading chances again. ASONGOFTHEHEART (8) gained a nice trail behind the leader and got up to defeat WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5) at Ballarat then took on a strong field in the Scotch Notch Trot. He should gain an economical run from the trailing draw and is worth an investment. FIRST IN FLIGHT (4), WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5) and WHITERING (7) are all capable of showing up without surprising. BACK: SHINELIKETHESUN – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SHINELIKETHESUN (2), TAURAS (6), ASONGOFTHEHEART (8), FIRST IN FLIGHT (4)

OVERVIEW: PASS THE SALT (3) is a handy 3yo trotter, which will appreciate a big drop back in class on his latest performances. He went from competing in the Super Series to the Need for Speed Prince series and his latest fifth was in the Scotch Notch Trot so he gets his chance to improve under these conditions. LITTLE MISS MORGAN (10) galloped several times in the run and lost her chance at Melton last time out. She still appeared to be a chance of running in the top three when she galloped approaching the home turn. She is a very smart mare when she is able to put it altogether and cannot be left out of calculations. DOSSIER (1) has had a few chances since her latest victory but she performs best when she is close to the speed so she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. KITTY CASH (8) should gain a nice trip from the inside of the second line and her overall form is sound so she rates as a value chance. BACK: PASS THE SALT – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PASS THE SALT (3), LITTLE MISS MORGAN (10), DOSSIER (1), KITTY CASH (8)

OVERVIEW:RUDY GEE (3) is the starting point here, being a very quick beginner who looks the likely leader and should be able to hold on over the short trip. He's won four of his last five in NSW, running good times, albeit against easier opposition than he faces here. His map advantage over some key rivals is a major factor in leaning his way, despite not boasting the strongest record at this track. JILLIBY SNIPER (6) won under similar conditions here last week, but that was an easier field, and he was able to find the top, which is unlikely to happen here. He's won five from eight this season and is a talented 3yo, but this is a new challenge. ANGELS WATCHING (1) looks to get the right draw to map behind the leader, but it's worth noting he is back in the draw after breaking at the start four runs back when a winner. It's a quality race, with KATUNGA EXPRESS (2), NEATNTIDY (5), STEEL THE MOMENT (9) and PISTOL PEARCE (12) all having chances at the minor end with the right run. BACK: RUDY GEE (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:RUDY GEE (3), JILLIBY SNIPER (6), ANGELS WATCHING (1), KATUNGA EXPRESS (2)

OVERVIEW:COLOSSAL HOPE (2) has been racing well without winning this preparation and now gets a good set-up to get back on top of the podium. He's a very quick beginner, as evidenced when he was able to cross from the outside last time out when racing several of the opposition here. James Herbertson is an important driver booking to get the best out of him with an ideal draw and map. PICK UP ELVIS (9) was a winner last start, beating a quality field, and was terrific prior when racing the elite 4yos in the Vicbred Series. He trails through behind the top pick and has beaten that horse previously. KEAYANG VIPER (10) is quite simply a winner, with seven victories from nine starts, but as good as she is, this race sets up a little differently. The market took her on here last week, but she was able to get a good trail through and prove too strong, whereas she's unlikely to get the same trip now. OLLIES THE BOSS (8) has an awkward draw to overcome but is racing well for the in-form stable. He will be driven for luck but will be strong late. TOORAM MAGIC (4), KOMODO (5) and ALL BLAZING GUNS (6) will need luck but are all in with a show. SELECTIONS:COLOSSAL HOPE (2), PICK UP ELVIS (9), KEAYANG VIPER (10), OLLIES THE BOSS (8)

OVERVIEW: A very speedy front line here, with virtually the entire front row normally liking to lead or race on the speed. That may suit NEW SHUFFLE (9), who is a sit-and-sprint type who excels when coming with one run off a fast tempo. He's well in with the concession claim and comes off a brief freshen-up following an excellent 4th in the Geelong Cup, where he found the line strongly. His overall record is very strong for a race of this nature. SEATHESTARS (3) looked like he was getting back to his best in his victory last week when he was able to lead all the way. It's uncertain how the map works out this time, but I'm happy to have him in the numbers, as his best is good enough. FAIRPLAY (7) is racing well this season, with five wins from six starts, but has drawn to map better on those occasions. He has talent, so despite a few things needing to work out, he can't be dismissed. SCHWARZ (2) had to work too hard last time, but from a better marble could get a nicer trip depending on tactics. JACCKA EVAN (6) won that race but is likely to go back, while stablemates BLAKE BOLAC (5) and ALWAYS BE BLAKEY (8) will need a lot to go their way but are racing well. BACK: NEW SHUFFLE (9) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:NEW SHUFFLE (9), SEATHESTARS (3), FAIRPLAY (7), SCHWARZ (2)

OVERVIEW:ENJOY LIFE (9) is a high-quality 3yo who comes through the A-grade form lines, including the Derby last start, where he travelled keenly behind the leader, who fell back into his lap, costing him all momentum before finishing not far away in 6th. His form prior was first-rate, albeit from better draws where he was able to dictate. He won't have that luxury now but can deliver a high-speed finish to overcome them. SEASIDE BOY (4) gets a better draw and actually beat home the top pick in the Derby, where he had to go back and worked home well. From this more favourable marble, expect a more aggressive drive, and he could prove hard to run down, particularly if he finds the lead. DECODE (2) will have something to say about the speed map and has been terrific this season. He's unfortunate not to have a better record, having faced some bad draws in major races. He was okay in the Derby, but with the others outperforming him there, that dampens confidence slightly. MOST EXCITING (8) has mixed his form a little this season, but more often that's been because of taking on the elite 3yos. He can only be driven for luck from this draw but will be strong late if the gaps come. There's not a runner who would surprise at the minor end for exotics. BACK: ENJOY LIFE (9) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ENJOY LIFE (9), SEASIDE BOY (4), DECODE (2), MOST EXCITING (8)

OVERVIEW:BULLETPROOF BOY (8) comes out of the Victoria Cup, where he had every chance and was fair in finishing 5th. Prior to that, he was terrific in winning the Smoken Up Sprint, but that was over his preferred distance. Even if he may not be at his elite best this preparation, he does bring the A-grade form to be the testing material at this level of FFA. JILLIBY NITRO (6) was terrific in winning the Geelong Cup two starts back at only his second run from a break. He then had a terrible draw and set-up in the Victoria Cup, so forget he went around. He has the tactical advantage of the three topliners here and has the versatility to command respect. CATCH A WAVE (7) may be obliged to press forward here, as he has done from the same draw recently, winning on one of those occasions, albeit over the shorter trip. He's going okay, and as an eight-time G1 winner, he can never be dismissed. SIR JIMMY (3) needs to come with one run, and he probably hasn't had much luck getting things to work out of late. He will enjoy this level of FFA, though, and is in the mix. COASTAL DRIVE (1) has been racing well and will look to use the draw to his advantage. It's just whether he's up to these over the trip. SELECTIONS:BULLETPROOF BOY (8), JILLIBY NITRO (6), CATCH A WAVE (7), SIR JIMMY (3)

OVERVIEW: The scratching of Twigstar has really changed the complexion of this race, as she would have led with the opposition happy to sit off her speed. Now it creates a bit of uncertainty with the map, and the major rival CATCH THE CAPTAIN (9) may be forced to put himself in the race from the back row. He was good on debut, so whilst the set-up looks a little different for him this time, he’s worth sticking with. FARADAY (5) did what she had to do winning on debut and wasn't breathtaking in that victory as a $1.18 favourite in a small field. She is from the top stable, however, so you can only expect improvement from that effort. DREAMS FOREVER (2) hasn't been the punters' pal, going down as a short-priced favourite in her last two, but did show ability in some earlier performances, while OZZIE TART (1) can use her speed to get a nice map and looks the other major player at the minor end. SELECTIONS:CATCH THE CAPTAIN (9), FARADAY (5), DREAMS FOREVER (2), OZZIE TART (1)

OVERVIEW:SEA FURY (9) was flying earlier in the year, but his last few runs haven't been up to that standard, at least numerically, as you could make a few small excuses. This is the most winnable race he's been in for a while, and the tick-over trial was good enough to suggest he's on track. He can bounce back against these. IM DOWNBYTHESEASIDE (6) was a good winner when able to lead from the same draw last campaign and looked to be progressing well, getting up in class quickly. This race looks much more suitable than his first-up assignment, and with added fitness, he will be hard to beat. WHERE IS WOODY (7) switches to one of Victoria's leading stables, and while the draw is no luxury, he's normally a one-run type, so may drift back and, with the right tempo, finish well. POPCORNFRIDAY (1) and BRINGUSJOY (2) would look for the lead but would need little pressure thereafter, while FIRE MARSHALL (8) is dependent on how that all works out in front of him.
